gloss_en: erekh apayim — 'long of nostrils/breath', i.e. slow to anger: the divine attribute of forbearance (from the Thirteen Attributes, Ex. 34:6), expounded by R. Nachman as patient endurance in divine service — extending one's spirit/breath (as in the sigh that draws the spirit of life) and remaining unshaken by any obstacle; attained through faith (emunah) and the Land of Israel
